title: Visual Jev: Accurate and Efficient Decisions from Shared Visual Context
abstract: arXiv:2609.25845v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many vision applications ask several independent, forced-choice questions about the same image. Visual Jev encodes the image and public context once, executes isolated question suffixes as a batch, and reads candidate probabilities from the backbone's language-model head. Across four benchmarks, answer-supervised post-training raises equal-weight macro accuracy from 70.6% to 76.1%, with the gain concentrated on the two task families represented in training. At N=32 questions per image, shared batched execution is 8.9x faster in warm amortized time than independent serial execution and remains 3.4x faster than an already-batched baseline that recomputes the prefix, at the cost of higher peak memory. A matched typed-head control offers no consistent accuracy advantage over the language-model-head readout. translated_title: Visual Jev：基于共享视觉上下文的准确高效决策
translated_abstract: 许多视觉应用会对同一张图像提出多个相互独立的强制选择题。Visual Jev 对图像和公共上下文只进行一次编码，将各个孤立的问题后缀作为一个批次执行，并从骨干网络的语言模型头读取候选概率。在四个基准测试中，答案监督的后训练将等权重宏平均准确率从 70.6% 提升至 76.1%，且增益集中在训练所涵盖的两个任务族上。在每张图像 N=32 个问题的设置下，共享批量执行在预热摊销时间上比独立串行执行快 8.9 倍，并且比一个已经批量化但需要重新计算前缀的基线快 3.4 倍，代价是更高的峰值内存占用。一个匹配的类型化头对照实验表明，相较于语言模型头读出方式，它并没有一致的准确率优势。因此，所支持的设计非常简单：为提升质量而适配骨干网络，保留现有的读出方式，并通过共享执行来提高效率。
tldr: Visual Jev 通过对同一图像只编码一次并批量执行多个问题后缀，在将准确率从 70.6% 提升至 76.1% 的同时，实现了最高 8.9 倍的推理加速。
en_tdlr: Visual Jev encodes each image once and batch-executes multiple question suffixes, raising accuracy from 70.6% to 76.1% while achieving up to 8.9x faster inference.
